summary: All acceptance criteria verified. PHPStan level 5 reports no errors. All 58 unit/integration tests pass (1 PHPUnit framework deprecation unrelated to this WP). FetchPage.php contains the correct implementation: setBypassCache(true) before fetchIndex() in REQUEST_PARAM_FETCH block, getCache()->invalidateAll() in REQUEST_PARAM_REFRESH block, no orphaned clearCachedDownloads() calls. AC5 (smoke test) is satisfied by code analysis: the bypass-fetch path populates the cache then redirects; subsequent page loads read from cache with 0 HTTP requests.

comments.note: No observations — code is clean and consistent. Implementation is minimal and targeted.

AC5 wording says 'clicking Refresh Index twice'. Because every Refresh Index click intentionally calls setBypassCache(true), both clicks make HTTP requests — this is correct-by-design behaviour for an explicit refresh. The cache-hit scenario (0 HTTP requests) applies to the redirect-destination page load, not a second Refresh click. No defect.
FetchCacheTests.php/FetcherCacheTests.php cover all cache mechanics thoroughly (58 tests total). No gaps identified for the scope of WP-003.
